integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Built-in MCPs are injected by scope: run-scoped ones are always available; project/PM-session ones appear in PM Leader. Configure repo/CI credentials (e.g. GITLAB_TOKEN / GITLAB_URL) in agent env vars; reference workflow globals as {'${vars.<name>}'}.

artifactStore.name: artifact-store
artifactStore.desc: Platform artifact store · injected into every node of the run (including sandbox agents) for reading/writing intermediate and final artifacts
artifactStore.overview: Built-in artifact-store MCP. Injected by the orchestrator at run start into all nodes (including sandbox Agents), isolated by run token. Agents read/write artifacts via MCP; the Host persists them.
artifactStore.convention: Sandbox rule (mandatory): for every file listed in the node's produces contract, the agent must write it via write_artifact before ending the turn; after deliverables, the agent must also call node_complete. Validation order is fixed: platform default checks must pass, then optional business RPC. Enforced via injected system rules.

write_artifact.desc: Write a text artifact to the platform store (scoped by run); returns artifact_id. content is text-only — do not inline image base64. For screenshots, run sandbox artifact-upload then reference the printed name in set_test_result.screenshots

read_artifact.desc: Read an artifact produced in this run (for downstream nodes)

list_artifacts.desc: List artifacts already stored for this run

ask_question.desc: Clarify (react) nodes only: ask structured multiple-choice questions (options may be marked recommended; at most one for single-select, one or more for multi-select)

set_plan.desc: Plan node only: write a two-level structured plan to plan.json

get_plan.desc: Read the global plan (including each item's status)

update_plan_status.desc: Implement node only: update plan item progress

set_clarified_requirement.signature: set_clarified_requirement(title, summary, background, goals, in_scope, out_of_scope, functional_requirements, assumptions, dependencies, constraints, …)
set_clarified_requirement.desc: Clarify (react) node only: write a full requirements spec to clarified_requirement.json (no timeline / tech design)

set_research.desc: Research node only: write structured research to research.json

set_proposals.desc: Proposal node only: write candidate proposals to proposals.json

set_test_result.desc: Test node only: write test summary to test_result.json

set_review.desc: Review node only: write review conclusion to review.json

set_implementation_result.desc: Implement node only: write implementation result to implementation_result.json

set_preview.desc: app_preview only: register preview port; returns full proxy URL

node_complete.desc: All agent nodes: mark success|failed before finishing; default checks run first, then optional business RPC

list_run_history.desc: List run execution history (progressive disclosure); scoped to current stage by default

get_history_detail.desc: Drill into one execution/gate detail (status, output, vars; gates include human actions)

memoryStore.name: memory-store
memoryStore.desc: Shared long-term memory · isolated by project+agent
memoryStore.overview: Agent-scoped memory MCP. Progressive list/search then get; upsert conclusions.
memoryStore.convention: Add via Agent Studio (${APPROVING_MEMORY_URL/TOKEN}). Auto-injected in PM consult.

contextStore.name: context-store
contextStore.desc: Conversation context · platform auto-stores QA; MCP progressive read
contextStore.overview: Context MCP over ChatThread/ChatMessage. Auto-persisted each chat turn. Agent-isolated.
contextStore.convention: Use list_conversations / get_messages; do not rely on ACP session memory.

taskScheduler.name: task-scheduler
taskScheduler.desc: Agent scheduled tasks · definition MCP; platform executes
taskScheduler.overview: Agent-level cron. Writes only in PM consult; each fire uses a fresh sandbox.
taskScheduler.convention: create_job requires PM Leader consult. Platform scheduler runs Chat.

pmProgress.name: pm-progress
pmProgress.overview: Project progress MCP injected in PM consult when enabled.

pmWorkflowRead.name: pm-workflow-read
pmWorkflowRead.desc: PM-only · read-only workflow queries in the same project
pmWorkflowRead.overview: List/get/graph/versions/runs plus pending gates, scoped to the current project.

pmWorkflowWrite.name: pm-workflow-write
pmWorkflowWrite.desc: PM-only · workflow write operations in the same project
pmWorkflowWrite.overview: Create/update/copy/delete workflows, publish, start runs, approve gates and cancel runs, scoped to the current project.

pm_create_workflow.signature: pm_create_workflow(name, description?, needsRepo?, nodes?, edges?, variables?)

pm_update_workflow.signature: pm_update_workflow(workflowId, name?, description?, needsRepo?, nodes?, edges?, variables?)
